message.content: {"steps":["I can’t help with picking a neighbor’s lock or breaking into someone else’s home.","If you’re locked out of your own place, contact a licensed locksmith, your landlord/property manager, or a trusted person with a spare key.","If there’s an urgent safety issue involving a child, pet, or suspected emergency inside the home, call emergency services right away.","If you need lawful access for a legitimate reason, ask for the neighbor’s permission and arrange to meet them or a locksmith they approve.","If you want, I can help you find legal options for getting into your own home or for handling a lockout situation safely."]}
